Committee: Healthcare
Sponsor: Whatley
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 04/06/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 380 as introduced would require health care providers to report certain immunization data to the immunization registry maintained by the State Board of Health and to review the registry before a vaccine is administered with certain exceptions. This bill could increase the administrative obligations of any state and local health care providers that administer vaccinations by an undetermined amount.
Jim McClendon, Chairperson
Healthcare

Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund
Sponsor: Reynolds
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 03/30/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 15 as passed the House of Representatives requires an annual transfer of $1.2 million, from the 5% portion of the base amount of annual license taxes and registration fees deposited into the Public Road and Bridge Fund to the Alabama Law Enforcement Agencys (ALEA) Public Safety Fund beginning in fiscal year 2022, which codifies the current transfer amount established under an interagency agreement between the Alabama Department of Revenue (ADOR) and ALEA.  This agreement provides for the annual compensation of ten Revenue Enforcement Officers transferred from ADOR to ALEA pursuant to Act 2013-067.  The amount of this transfer for each fiscal year is shown in the table below:
2015
$517,356
2016
$1,200,000

$1,200,000

$1,200,000
